$description: Inventory of every component published to the Figma library '💠 ES Illustration'. Generated from the Figma library index, not hand-typed. status: stable = use it | deprecated = never use in new work | internal = private sub-part, do not place directly | snowflake = one-off exception, do not reuse | draft = unfinished. Pages: 'Standard Sizes' is the set to use, 'Sources' holds the master artwork, 'Special Sizes' and 'Export' are production leftovers.
